svg.text: The two added keys, read as a bar: token jobs of the prompt_or_mixed class = kv_only_jobs + listener_jobs
Bars to scale within each row. Blue = listener_jobs (a token job that received logits). Orange = kv_only_jobs (a prompt token that only stored K and V).

g.text: 64 = one chunk end per user per forward (8 x 8). No generated token is in this class: pure prefill.
64 = 8 chunk ends (A) + 56 generated tokens (B to H, 7 per forward).
The 56 are the decode work hidden in this class.

svg.text: 4 users in prefill, 4 in decode, 8 forwards

g.text: 64 = 32 chunk ends + 32 generated tokens. Same listener count as above, different meaning.
The reader needs the forwards count too: 8 listener jobs per forward = 4 chunk ends + 4 decode tokens.

svg.text: Reading rule: listener_jobs per forward, minus the users in prefill, = generated tokens hidden in the class per forward.
The leaf does not carry the users-in-prefill count. A reader takes it from the run (users per engine, prompt length),
or from the decode_like class, whose listener_jobs per forward is the number of users decoding at once.
Every number here is a computed example, not a measurement.
